sentences.text: He would also submit that the appellant is HIV positive and his treatment is continuing.
He would refer the documents submitted on 20-02-2026 with respect to ailment of the appellant by HIV positive.
He would also submit that during the trial the appellant was on bail and presently he is in jail since 07-11-2024.
The appeal is of year 2024 and its final disposal will take its own time.
Therefore, the appellant may be enlarged on bail.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, considering the nature of allegation against the appellant, evidence of the victim as well as other witnesses, further considering that there is no injury found on the body of the victim, manner in which the alleged offence is said to have been committed and further considering the facts that the appellant is HIV positive, during the trial the appellant was on bail and final adjudication of the case will take its own time, we are inclined to suspend the sentence awarded to the appellant and released him on bail.
Consequently, I.A. No.01/2024 is allowed.
Accordingly, the substantive jail sentence awarded to appellant by the learned trial Court is hereby suspended.

He shall be released on bail on his executing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.25,000/-
with one surety of the like sum to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 16-04-2026.

He shall thereafter, appear before the concerned trial Court on a date to be given by the Registry of this Court and shall continue to appear there on all such subsequent dates as are given to him by the said Court, till final disposal of this appeal.
List this appeal for final hearing.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Ravindra Kumar Agrawal) (Ramesh Sinha)
